recorded.note: Regtest uses mainnet address prefixes. Amounts are piconero as decimal strings. `tx_hex` is the full transaction; `pruned_hex` with `prunable_hash` is what a pruned node returns. Keys below are throwaway regtest keys.

errors.no-output: no output of the transaction pays the joint address
errors.amount-too-small: the output to the joint address pays less than min_amount
errors.txid-mismatch: the blob does not hash to the transaction id
errors.output-not-found: the named output does not pay the joint address
errors.duplicate-output-key: another output in the lock transaction or its block carries the same one-time key

cases.name: lock
cases.about: a 2 XMR lock to the joint address

cases.name: lock-with-additional-tx-keys
cases.about: the lock transaction also pays a subaddress, so outputs use per-output additional tx keys

cases.name: one-view-half-is-not-the-view-key
cases.about: scanning with a single view share finds nothing

cases.name: wrong-spend-key
cases.about: the joint view key with one spend half as the spend key finds nothing

cases.name: amount-one-piconero-short
cases.about: the lock pays one piconero less than required

cases.name: blob-does-not-hash-to-txid
cases.about: the last byte of the blob was changed

cases.name: dust-in-the-lock-block
cases.about: two dust payments to the joint address share the block with the lock: the lock verifies, and a sweep must spend exactly the lock output and report the rest as ignored

cases.name: dust-output-named-as-the-lock
cases.about: the same block, naming a dust payment as the lock: it pays far less than required

cases.name: no-such-output-in-the-block
cases.about: the same block, naming an output index of the lock transaction that does not pay the joint address

cases.name: duplicate-output-key
cases.about: SYNTHETIC. The lock block with one more transaction whose output carries the lock's one-time key (the lock transaction with one key-image byte changed; it parses and scans like a real duplicate but was never on the chain). Two outputs with one key share a key image, so only one can ever be spent: verification must report the lock invalid and a sweep must refuse.
